summary: Russian forces captured Konstantinovka, triggering clearance operations and continued assaults across northern and eastern fronts. Ukrainian forces reported drone strikes on fuel infrastructure in Zaporizhzhia and Kharkiv regions, causing casualties. The EU debated easing visa restrictions for Russian citizens linked to the war, while Bulgaria sought MiG-29 parts amid ongoing air threats.
key_points: Russian forces captured Konstantinovka, with ongoing clearance and demining operations reported (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31488).
Ukrainian drone strikes hit fuel infrastructure in Zaporizhzhia, causing fires and at least three injured and one killed (Source: @UkraineNow/82536).

Drone activity reported across multiple regions including Kharkiv, Chernihiv, and Zaporizhzhia, with reactive drones targeting northern and eastern areas (Source: @kpszsu/67864, @kpszsu/67866, @kpszsu/67861, @kpszsu/67860).
EU discussed easing visa restrictions for Russian citizens involved in the 'special military operation' (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31499).
Bulgaria sought MiG-29 spare parts to maintain airworthiness amid Geran drone threats (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31507).
Ukrainian MP Tyshchenko posted UAH 10 million bail in a bribery case involving extortion and money laundering (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31508).
Slovenian parliament rejected €44 million in military aid to Ukraine, citing domestic needs (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31510).

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces have consolidated gains in eastern Ukraine, with Konstantinovka's capture enabling strategic positioning along key supply routes. Ukrainian drone strikes on fuel infrastructure pose logistical challenges for Russian forces, while increased civilian casualties in border regions suggest escalation risks. Bulgaria's pursuit of MiG-29 parts highlights NATO allies' concerns about air defense capabilities amid ongoing Geran drone threats.
sections.regional_response: EU members remain divided on military aid, with Slovenia rejecting new funding while Bulgaria seeks to preserve its air fleet through parts acquisition. Polish-Ukrainian tensions emerged over MiG-29 transfers, reflecting broader NATO coordination challenges. Ukrainian authorities emphasized anti-corruption measures following high-profile arrests, signaling efforts to maintain international support amid ongoing combat operations.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian forces demonstrate coordinated advances in eastern and northern fronts, leveraging captured positions for further operations. Ukrainian drone tactics target critical infrastructure, indicating evolving asymmetric warfare strategies. EU policy shifts on Russian sanctions reveal alliance fragmentation, potentially impacting long-term support dynamics. Bulgaria's proactive approach to maintaining air capabilities underscores regional security calculations amid ongoing threats.
